raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

The 2-GPU and 4-GPU jobs of the miles ROCm 10 MI35X nightly have failed every night since Oct 14 and Oct 6, without reporting most of their tests. This PR changes how the workflow schedules those suites. No test code changes.

## Why

**2-GPU suite: the runner goes down.** Every night since Oct 14 the `linux-mi35x-gpu-2` runner stops about 2 minutes into `test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py`, and the job ends with "The self-hosted runner lost communication with the server" ([Oct 20](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39467587161/job/118782916394), [Oct 19](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39295602704)). The test moved from the 4-GPU suite to the 2-GPU suite in radixark/miles#4053 (merged Oct 13). Before that, it ran on the 8-GPU pool and passed in 729 s ([Oct 12](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38285672256)). The suite now runs on `linux-mi35x-gpu-8`, the same pool the 4-GPU suite already uses.

**4-GPU suite: the step timeout cuts it off.** The suite has 30 tests with ~22,000 s of estimated time, about 3.5 h of real time on MI355X, and the step timeout is 180 min. Every night since Oct 6 the step has timed out partway through ([Oct 20](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39467587161/job/118782916392): stopped at test 22 of 30). The suite is now split into two partitions with `run_suite.py --auto-partition-id/--auto-partition-size`, the same split radixark/miles uses for `stage-c-4-gpu-mi350` in its own ROCm PR CI. Each half is ~11,000 s estimated.

**MI30X.** The GLM-5.2 skip (its kernel needs more LDS than gfx942 has) moves along with the test from the 4-GPU entry to the 2-GPU entry. On MI300 the test now fails in the 2-GPU job ([Oct 19](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39325011628)).

## Notes for the reviewer

- On MI35X this takes four 8-GPU runners per night instead of two 8-GPU runners and one 2-GPU runner.
- Partitioning is deterministic (LPT on `est_time`, ties broken by filename), so the two jobs agree on the split without coordinating.
- `test_qwen3_4B_variable_gbs.py` fails with `HIPBLASLT Error: 6` in TransformerEngine. That is a real failure, and this PR leaves it alone.

## Test plan

Dispatched the MI35X workflow on this branch: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39542005262. All four jobs finished inside the step timeout and reported every test:

| Job | Runner | Job time | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2-GPU | `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` | 131 min | 33/33 passed, including GLM-5.2 5-layer (829 s) |
| 4-GPU part 1/2 | `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` | 100 min | 14/15 passed |
| 4-GPU part 2/2 | `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` | 148 min | 14/15 passed |
| 8-GPU | `linux-mi35x-gpu-8` | 160 min | 19/19 passed |

The two 4-GPU failures are test failures, not scheduling:
- `test_nospec_nor3_bf16_sgl_dpattn2x2_meg_tp2pp2.py`: the CI log-prob check failed on a difference of 3e-8 (`-0.4064931571` vs `-0.4064931273`). It passed on Oct 20.
- `test_inkling_small_6layer_lora_ci.py`: one SGLang engine failed to start because `cargo --version --verbose` returned non-zero while it was loading the Inkling Rust image processor. The rollout then got 503s until the 1800 s file timeout. It passed in 473 s on Oct 20, so this looks intermittent. The 30 min timeout is part of part 2/2's 148 min.

The MI30X change was not dispatched; it only moves an existing skip entry.

nodes.body: The `HIPBLASLT Error: 6` in `test_qwen3_4B_variable_gbs.py` comes from TE's 64 MiB gfx950 GEMM workspace being too small for some ROCm 10.0 hipBLASLt kernels; XinyuJiangCMU/TransformerEngine#8 raises it to 128 MiB

Why skip `tests/e2e/megatron/test_qwen3_5_35B_A3B/test_nospec_nor3_bf16_sgl_dpattn2x2_meg_tp2pp2.py`? It passes: in the full Oct 20 [4-GPU job log](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39467587161/job/118782916392) it ran from 19:37:21Z to 19:53:38Z (978 s) and six more files ran after it. The web view truncates this ~28 MB log.

Alternatively, on the Miles side I can move only `test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py` to the 8-GPU nightly suite, so the rest of the 2-GPU suite stays on `linux-mi35x-gpu-2` and the nightly needs three 8-GPU runners instead of four. Happy to open that PR if you prefer it.

Thanks. You're right about `dpattn2x2`: the log I read was truncated. I've dropped the skip, and the PR now only partitions the 4-GPU suite. New validation run: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39542005262

On moving GLM-5.2: the 8-GPU job's test step took 161 of its 180 min on Oct 20, so adding ~12 min there leaves little margin. Moving it back to `nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350` would save the same 8-GPU runner, since each partitioned half is ~11,000 s estimated. If you open that Miles PR, I'll put the 2-GPU suite back on `linux-mi35x-gpu-2` here. @XinyuJiangCMU

files.patch:
@@ -34,15 +34,18 @@ jobs:
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-2-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-2gpu-sglang
             timeout: 180
-            # Single-request decode of Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 runs at ~20 tok/s on MI300X, so long
-            # generations outlast the test client's 180 s request timeout.
-            skip_tests: tests/e2e/sglang/test_session_server_multi_role/test_qwen38small.py
+            # test_qwen38small: single-request decode of Qwen3.8-27B-FP8 runs at ~20 tok/s on
+            # MI300X, so long generations outlast the test client's 180 s request timeout.
+            # test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci: its tilelang indexer kernel needs 98 KiB of LDS
+            # per block; gfx942 has 64 KiB.
+            skip_tests: >-
+              tests/e2e/sglang/test_session_server_multi_role/test_qwen38small.py
+              tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py
           # The 4- and 8-GPU suites run past 180 min on MI300X; they take ~155 and ~112 min on MI355X.
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-4gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300
-            # Its tilelang indexer kernel needs 98 KiB of LDS per block; gfx942 has 64 KiB.
-            skip_tests: tests/e2e/megatron/model_scripts/test_glm5_2_744b_a40b_5layer_ci.py
+            skip_tests: ""
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi300-8gpu-sglang
             timeout: 300

@@ -24,15 +24,28 @@ concurrency:
 jobs:
   test-miles-mi35x:
     if: github.repository == 'sgl-project/sglang'
+    name: test-miles-mi35x (${{ matrix.suite }}, ${{ matrix.runner }}${{ matrix.partition_size && format(', part {0}', matrix.part) || '' }})
     strategy:
       fail-fast: false
       matrix:
+        # All suites use the 8-GPU MI35X pool. The 2-GPU suite includes the
+        # GLM-5.2 5-layer test, which takes the linux-mi35x-gpu-2 runner down
+        # ("runner lost communication") but passes on an 8-GPU runner.
         include:
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-2-gpu-mi350
-            runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-2
-          # Use 8-GPU MI35X pool for 4-GPU suite.
+            runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+          # The 4-GPU suite is ~6 h of estimated test time; split it so each
+          # half fits in the step timeout.
+          - suite: nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350
+            runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+            partition_id: 0
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 1/2
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-4-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
+            partition_id: 1
+            partition_size: 2
+            part: 2/2
           - suite: nightly-stage-c-8-gpu-mi350
             runner: linux-mi35x-gpu-8
     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
@@ -88,6 +101,7 @@ jobs:
             -e PYTHONPATH=/root/miles:/opt/tilelang \
             -e GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/sglang-checkout/github_summary.md \
             python3 tests/ci/run_suite.py --hw rocm --suite ${{ matrix.suite }} --cadence nightly \
+            ${{ matrix.partition_size && format('--auto-partition-id {0} --auto-partition-size {1}', matrix.partition_id, matrix.partition_size) || '' }} \
             ${{ (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }} || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
           cat "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/github_summary.md" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true
           exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE}
